evidence.structure: DOM SCAFFOLDING measured against the live original (independently re-counted from the real JSX: /privacy-policy h1:1 h2:12 h3:2 p:39 li:31 a:15 table:2 tr:25 td:105; /terms-of-service h1:1 h2:16 h3:1 p:63 li:30 a:21 - both match exactly). THE BODY PROSE IS DELIBERATE PLACEHOLDER FILLER, not the original's copy, because shipping another company's policy text is a liability. Any word budget derived from these pages measures the filler, NOT a measured copy budget.
evidence.copy: placeholder-filler (headings and anchor labels are the measured scaffolding; body prose is deliberate filler)

motion.detail: section.tech has no motion hook of its own: no data-flash, no data-hero-text, no ScrollTrigger. The only motion on the legal routes is the global chrome.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Unchanged - this section has no motion of its own.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.base: single column, 8rem top offset, 2rem side gutters; the .tech__title override renders the .u-h3 element at type.h1 (5.5rem)
responsive.max-991px: the overridden title drops 5.5rem -> 4.5rem and body.lead stays 1.125rem
responsive.max-767px: the overridden title drops to 2.5rem and body.lead to 1rem

purpose: One heading-bounded chapter of a legal document: the anchor embed target, a numbered h2 and its paragraphs, lists, sub-headings and (on /privacy-policy) tables. Repeats 12-16 times per legal page, once per h2.

heading.note: Measured: a numbered h2, 2-7 words including the leading number.

anchorPattern.note: REAL DIFFERENCE between the two legal pages: /terms-of-service uses 16 <div id> embed targets and puts NO id on its h2 elements (div-embed-only), while /privacy-policy duplicates each slug onto BOTH the <div id> embed AND the h2 (div-embed-and-h2-id). Both are valid Webflow rich-text anchor patterns and both are reproduced verbatim.

tables.note: Measured: 2 tables on /privacy-policy (25 tr, 105 td in total), 0 on /terms-of-service.

contentMaxWordsTotalNote: No section-wide total: paragraphs and list items are unbudgeted placeholder filler. heading, subHeadings and table header cells carry their own maxWords.
unbudgetedFieldsNote: These are the legal pages' body prose, which is deliberate PLACEHOLDER FILLER rather than the original's copy. A maxWords derived from filler would be a fabricated measurement. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] exempts them by name.

constraints.verification: Repeated once per h2: 12 on /privacy-policy (src/pages/PrivacyContent.jsx:34-273), 16 on /terms-of-service (src/pages/TermsContent.jsx:41-171). Each starts at a <div className="w-embed"> anchor target directly followed by its h2.

notes: Two anchor patterns are real and both are reproduced: /terms-of-service puts the slug only on the <div id> embed target (div-embed-only); /privacy-policy also repeats it on the h2 (div-embed-and-h2-id).
